member.name: M:Checkers.Controllers.GamesController.ExceptionResult(System.String,System.Exception)
member.summary: Maps an exception that escaped an action to an HTTP response: input errors (out-of-range indexes, bad arguments, malformed values) become 400 with the exception message, anything else is logged and answered with a generic 500 so internals never leak.
